subject: Re: Appointment
text:
Yes, that appointment works. I had to rearrange the morning, but the room is confirmed and the reminder went out already.

The unexpected part was good news: the coordinator said our extra time slot opened up after another group canceled. If we still have enough volunteers, we can run the short demo and still leave a gap for the follow-up discussion.

I am sending the updated list in a moment. Please glance at it before noon and let me know if anyone is missing. I would rather fix small omissions now than chase them later.

I also noticed the sign-in sheet still has the old date, so I will reprint it. If the printer jams, I will bring a spare copy from the office.

Sorry for the quick wording. Thanks again.
